text: Carpentry is the art and craft of constructing and modifying structures from wood, primarily for residential and commercial use. At the heart of carpentry are joints, which connect pieces of wood to form complete structures. Common joints include the mortise and tenon, dovetail, and biscuit. These joints provide strength and stability while allowing for flexibility in design and construction. After the basic framework is assembled, varnish is applied to protect the wood and enhance the aesthetic appeal of the finished project. Varnishing seals out moisture and prevents wood rot, while also protecting the wood from dust and wear.
